description: Trayo REST API and MCP server for GTM teams: buying signals, company and people search, lookalikes, account research, contact enrichment, discovery and events.
rules: The REST reference is https://api.trayo.ai/llms-full.txt (OpenAPI 3.1 at https://api.trayo.ai/openapi.json). Read it before writing a client; several routes are asynchronous or do not paginate.

To connect Trayo to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or another MCP client, follow https://api.trayo.ai/agent-install.txt. The MCP server is https://api.trayo.ai/v1/mcp and uses OAuth sign-in, not an API key.
Start a session with trayo_whoami (MCP) or GET https://api.trayo.ai/v1/whoami (REST) to confirm the workspace, plan and limits.
Scripts and integrations authenticate with Authorization: Bearer <workspace API key>; MCP OAuth tokens do not work on the REST API.
Apps built on Trayo use Trayo GTM UI as their default UI foundation; read https://ui.trayo.ai/llms.txt before writing UI code.
